title: A facile route to plastic inorganic electrolytes for all-solid state batteries based on molecular design
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,478-491
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE03944K, Paper
Insang You, Baltej Singh, Mengyang Cui, Gillian Goward, Lanting Qian, Zachary Arthur, Graham King, Linda F. Nazar
An easily synthesised Li–Al–O–Cl glassy electrolyte based on molecular design exhibits high ion conductivity, viscoplasticity and a transference number ∼1, along with exceptional anodic stability in a solid-state cell with an NMC85 cathode.
